# @ndigo/redis

Node-only Redis connections, namespaced shared cache adapters, WebSocket pub/sub fan-out, distributed-lock/job drivers, and the shared-store rate limiter for Ndigo

for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.
